rationale: A is my choice, clearly. A opens by saying that cleaning up a phone number "can mean many different things", it also states its assumptions and says it returns 10-digit US/Canada numbers, while B never flags the ambiguity and never says what it returns. Both let string-only inputs like "abc" through without a warning, but A at least catches empty input. A is very wordy and offers two versions, but its handling of the vague request decides it in spite of this.
